item.title: Add Title
item.description: This is my very first blog post, and instead of diving into a technical topic straight away, I want to share why I’m even starting this journey of writing and publishing in the first place. Over the past few months, I’ve had conversations with my uncle, some of my seniors, a teacher I really admire, and even a few close friends. All these discussions circled back to one powerful idea: document what you do.
